title: chore(deps): update vulnerable dependencies
author: Kielek
body:
# Changes

Updates vulnerable dependencies across the root tooling and affected demo services. It fixes 29 of 30 issues from scorecard.

The changes update:

* `brace-expansion` and `js-yaml` in the root tooling
* `cryptography` in `agent`
* `Pillow` in `chatbot`
* Next.js, Sharp, PostCSS, ProtobufJS, and `brace-expansion` in `frontend`
* `golang.org/x/text` and gRPC in `load-generator`
* `aiohttp` and `cryptography` in `mcp`
* `golang.org/x/net` and `golang.org/x/text` in `product-catalog`
* PostCSS and `brace-expansion` in `react-native-app`
* PyMdown Extensions in `telemetry-docs`

A recursive OSV scan no longer reports 29 of the 30 original advisories.

`GO-2026-5932` remains as a module-level finding in `checkout`. The dependency is introduced through `IBM/sarama -> gokrb5 -> golang.org/x/crypto/md4`, while the advisory only affects the unused `golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp` packages. Sarama is already at the latest release, the advisory has no fixed version, and `govulncheck ./...` reports no vulnerabilities affecting the checkout code.

## Merge Requirements

For new features contributions, please make sure you have completed the following
essential items:

* ~~[ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated to document new feature additions~~ — not applicable; this PR contains dependency updates only
* ~~[ ] Appropriate documentation updates in the [docs][]~~ — not applicable; no documented behavior changes
* ~~[ ] Appropriate Helm chart updates in the [helm-charts][]~~ — not applicable; no deployment configuration changes

A Pull Request that modifies instrumentation code will likely require an
update in docs. Please make sure to update the opentelemetry.io repo with any

Other changes affecting how a service is deployed will also likely require an
